ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
(function(){
let sourceUrl = GET('server');

// 遍历页面引用的全部 /templates/js/*.js，直到找到含AES密钥的那个
// （部分站点如 x630xsw/369shuba 的首个JS是无密钥的公共文件）
let regex = /src="(\/templates\/js\/[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,}\.js)"/g;
let m, bookId = result.match(/content=".*\/book\/(.*?)\.html"/)[1];
SET('bookId', bookId);
java.log('bookId: ' + bookId);

// 菠萝猫站点无需AES密钥（HTML目录）
if (sourceUrl.indexOf('boluomao') >= 0) { return result; }

let found = false;
while ((m = regex.exec(result)) !== null) {
  let jsUrl = sourceUrl + m[1];
  let resp = String(java.ajax(jsUrl));
  let secretKey = (resp.match(/AESCrypt\('(.*?)'\);/) || [])[1];
  let ivKey = (resp.match(/parse\('(.*?)'\);/) || [])[1];
  if (secretKey && ivKey) {
    cache.put(sourceUrl, JSON.stringify({ secretKey, ivKey }));
    java.log('密钥来源: ' + m[1]);
    found = true;
    break;
  }
}
if (!found) java.log('警告: 未能提取AES密钥');

return result;
})();
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var id = GET('bookId')
var serverUrl = GET('server')

// ===== 菠萝猫分支：HTML目录(#chapters)，按 ?cp=N 分页抓取合并 =====
if (serverUrl.indexOf('boluomao') >= 0) {
  let bmRes = [];
  let order = 0;
  let total = 1;
  for (let cp = 1; ; cp++) {
    let u = serverUrl + '/book/' + id + '.html' + (cp > 1 ? '?cp=' + cp : '');
    let html = String(java.ajax(u));
    let doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
    let as = doc.select('#chapters ul li a');
    if (as.size() == 0 && cp > 1) break;
    for (let i = 0; i < as.size(); i++) {
      let a = as.get(i);
      let href = a.attr('href');
      if (!href || href.indexOf('/read/') < 0) continue;
      bmRes.push(JSON.stringify({ chaptername: a.text().trim(), chapterurl: href, chapterorder: order++ }));
    }
    // 从书籍页的分页条取最大页码（仅首页需要解析一次）
    if (cp == 1) {
      let t = String(doc.select('.page-range-list a').last().attr('href')).match(/cp=(\d+)/);
      total = t ? parseInt(t[1]) : 1;
      java.log('BM目录总页数: ' + total);
      if (!(total >= 1)) total = 1;
    }
    if (cp >= total) break;
  }
  bmRes.sort((a, b) => JSON.parse(a).chapterorder - JSON.parse(b).chapterorder);
  bmRes;
} else {

aid = `[data-aid="${id}"]@li||[data-aid="${id}"]@option`
var pages = java.getElements(aid);
java.log("aid: " + aid)
java.log("pages: " + pages.length)
if (pages.length==0) {
  url = GET('server')+"/chapter/"+id+".html"
  so = java.ajax(url);

  if (/404/.test(so)) { 
    url = url.replace('chapter', 'book')
    so = java.ajax(url);
  }
  java.log(url)

  java.setContent(so);
  pages = java.getElements(aid);
}
pages = pages.length;
java.log("pages: " + pages)

// POST 请求头：部分站点(x630xsw/369shuba)的WAF会对无Referer的POST弹验证
let hd = JSON.stringify({
  "Referer": GET('server') + "/",
  "Origin": GET('server'),
  "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest",
  "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
});

let res = [];
for (let page = 1; page <= pages; page ++) {
let body = JSON.stringify({ id, page });
let url = GET('server') + "/index.php?action=loadChapterPage," + JSON.stringify({
  "body": `data=${dataEncrypt(body)}`,
  "method": "POST",
  "headers": hd
});

let resp = java.ajax(url);
resp = JSON.parse(resp);
resp = resp.data;
resp.forEach(x=>{
res.push(JSON.stringify(x))
});
}

res.sort((a, b) => JSON.parse(a).chapterorder - JSON.parse(b).chapterorder);
res;
</js>
